verdict.rationale: This story concerns API-client collections and workspaces: saved request collections exported in portable formats such as Postman or Insomnia files. The evidence shows Kong is an API gateway and API management platform (gateway, AI Gateway, Konnect, Dev Portal, decK, kongctl), with no API-client collection feature. decK's declarative config and Dev Portal's OpenAPI publishing are gateway configuration and documentation surfaces, not collection import/export, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import and export collections in portable formats to move between tools
